decisions.name: pwt_all.na
decisions.reason: Only verified accessible delivery of this unversioned national-accounts layout with explicitly 1996-base expenditure columns. Accessible na70 has a different 22-column layout and named 7.0 release; exact replacement equivalence is not established. Preserve the unknown release identity and do not label this PWT 11 or currently maintained.

decisions.name: wrdsappssamp_all.ccmxpf_lnkhist

Another CRSP sample exists with a different layout, but no verified full accessible replacement or sample-equivalence mapping was established. Keep the sample restriction.

decisions.name: wrdsappssamp_all.ciqkeydev
decisions.reason: Restricted key-development text sample has an accessible documented full CIQ endpoint providing keydevid and situation. Prefer the full product; sample maintenance is still unverified.

decisions.name: wrdsappssamp_all.ciqkeydevint
decisions.reason: Only observed application delivery explicitly identified as the international key-development text sample. The full CIQ endpoint is accessible, but exact equivalence of this international selection was not established. Preserve the sample scope and unknown maintenance.

decisions.name: wrdsappssamp_all.country
decisions.reason: Only accessible observed sample dictionary linking FIC, currency, series_name and observation date bounds. The WRDS international event-study country endpoint is inaccessible, and unrelated country dictionaries are not verified replacements. Preserve the sample scope.

decisions.name: wrdsappssamp_all.dsedelist

decisions.name: wrdsappssamp_all.wrds_keydev

Full ciq_keydev.wrds_keydev is accessible but uses companyid and is not a verified equivalent prelinked delivery. Preserve sample scope; use full CIQ plus a separately validated link for broader research.
